results.answer: Southwest's 87 737 MAX 8 aircraft were all on MCAS v1.7.3 as of January 2024, with FAA AD 2024-01-02 (requiring MCAS Software v2.0) marked COMPLIANCE DUE with a May 15, 2024 deadline; software updates were scheduled February-May 2024 in phases of roughly 10 aircraft/month. Southwest had previously complied with FAA AD 2020-05-11 (all 87 aircraft, pre-service compliance Nov 2020) and FAA AD 2022-03-07 (all 87 aircraft, completed April 2022). FAA AD 2024-01-02 requires MCAS Software v2.0 installation, and operators of 737-8 and 737-9 aircraft are legally required to comply with all applicable ADs under 14 CFR Part 39, with non-compliance rendering the aircraft unairworthy under FAA jurisdiction. The MCAS v2.0 target corresponds to Boeing Service Bulletin Rev 2.
